title: Chapter close — Mass endomorphism
html:
This completes the algebraic theory of the mass endomorphism: the categorical mass identity and its four-term topological decomposition, the Jones–Markov trace engine at z = q^3/(q^2+1) and its \mathfrak{sl}_2 Ocneanu classification, the complex volume \mathfrak{V} = \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{bind}} + i\,\mathfrak{Q}_\beta, the exact cyclotomic \chi^\lambda closed forms on H_3(q), and the Hecke–Baer-* chirality pairing.

The next chapter (q-Hyperbolic Geometry) develops the geometric counterpart of this algebraic trace—the categorical Möbius self-avoidance energy, crossing-energy asymmetry, Lagrange resolvent kinematics, and knot-operator shadow prices—before Mass Analysis and Nuclear Interactions and Binding combine both faces into the elementary-particle and nuclear mass pipeline.
